inlines.v: LAX'ATIVE, adjective [Latin laxo.] Having the power or quality of loosening or opening the bowels, and relieving from constipation. LAX'ATIVE, noun A medicine that relaxes the bowels and relieves from costiveness; a gentle purgative.
